MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Partners feels like a natural next choice because vocal duets connect with the polished singing and musical performances I have been choosing.",
    "25 appeals through expressive vocals and melodic ballads, while Tornado connects with the country harmonies I enjoy in Golden and 747.",
    "That's Christmas To Me reflects my interest in Christmas music, even though I would save it for the holiday season."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Ultimate Waylon Jennings feels less suited to my current mood because I am looking for smooth vocal ensembles and melodic pop-country; a country connection alone is not enough.",
    "I cannot confidently connect The Very Best Of or 21 Number Ones to my taste without knowing the artist, and Oscd Ad Adele 21 leaves me uncertain about the release.",
    "Glen Campbell: Greatest Hits and To All The Girls... have some appeal, but that does not make them albums I would choose over Partners or 25 today."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in Golden and 747 seems to have been stretched into a broader interest in country collections than my current choices support.",
    "Recognizable hits and retrospective collections seem to be treated as appealing in themselves, whereas I need a connection to the singing and musical mood."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The recurring appeal across my choices is polished, expressive singing, especially harmonies, duets, and ensemble performances.",
    "My latest choice of relaxing classical music suggests that a calm listening mood also matters alongside my interest in vocal albums.",
    "Seasonal interest is different from immediate interest: enjoying Christmas music does not mean I want to choose it throughout the year."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly understood my interest in expressive vocals and harmonies, but extended my country and Christmas interests beyond what I would choose right now."
}
